passages.title: Noun Groups: A New Reading Corner
passages.text: Last month, the school library opened a new reading corner beside its tall windows. A low wooden shelf holds short story books, picture dictionaries, and several large-print guides. On the pale blue wall, a simple map of the library shows quiet study areas. Two soft floor cushions sit under a round table with a smooth surface. A small reading lamp with a flexible neck stands near the shelf. The librarian placed clear labels above each group of books, so younger students can find the right section. A narrow sign beside the entrance explains the quiet-reading rules. Many students now use the corner after lunch. Some read alone, while others choose a short book to share with a friend. At the end of the first week, the librarian asked visitors what they liked. Several students mentioned the soft cushions and the lamp with a flexible neck. One student suggested adding a second shelf for books about science. The librarian will consider the suggestion before changing the display. The new space gives the library a calm place for reading and study.

questions.prompt: What is the passage mainly about?
choices: A new reading corner and the details that make it useful.
A plan to close the school library.
The history of a famous collection of books.
Instructions for making a reading lamp.
questions.explanation: Bacaan menjelaskan sudut baca baru di perpustakaan, benda-benda yang tersedia, dan cara rincian tersebut membantu pengunjung. Teks tidak membahas penutupan perpustakaan, sejarah koleksi terkenal, atau petunjuk membuat lampu.

translationId.prompt: Apa pokok bahasan utama bacaan tersebut?
choices: Sudut baca baru dan rincian yang membuatnya berguna.

questions.evidence: The new space gives the library a calm place for reading and study.

questions.prompt: What is the head noun in the group “a low wooden shelf”?
questions.explanation: “Shelf” menamai benda utama yang dibicarakan. “Low” menjelaskan ukuran rak, sedangkan “wooden” menunjukkan bahannya. “Books” muncul setelahnya sebagai benda yang disimpan di rak, bukan inti kelompok kata tersebut.

translationId.prompt: Apa nomina inti dalam kelompok kata “a low wooden shelf”?

questions.evidence: A low wooden shelf holds short story books, picture dictionaries, and several large-print guides.

questions.prompt: What does “with a flexible neck” add to the noun group about the lamp?
choices: It tells where the lamp is located.
It tells how many lamps are in the room.
It describes one feature of the lamp.
It names the person who owns the lamp.
questions.explanation: Frasa “with a flexible neck” berada setelah head noun “lamp” dan menjelaskan salah satu cirinya. Frasa itu tidak menunjukkan jumlah lampu, lokasi lampu, atau pemiliknya.

translationId.prompt: Apa informasi yang ditambahkan oleh “with a flexible neck” pada kelompok kata tentang lampu?
choices: Frasa itu menunjukkan jumlah lampu di ruangan.
Frasa itu menjelaskan salah satu ciri lampu.
Frasa itu menyebutkan orang yang memiliki lampu.

questions.evidence: A small reading lamp with a flexible neck stands near the shelf.

questions.prompt: What does “several” tell the reader in “several large-print guides”?
questions.explanation: “Several” menunjukkan jumlah yang lebih dari satu, tetapi tidak menyebut angka tertentu. Kata tersebut membatasi jumlah “guides”; kata itu bukan nomina inti dan bukan penjelas warna atau bahan.

translationId.prompt: Apa yang diberitahukan oleh “several” dalam “several large-print guides”?

questions.evidence: A low wooden shelf holds short story books, picture dictionaries, and several large-print guides.

questions.prompt: Which phrase tells where the new reading corner is located?
questions.explanation: Frasa “beside its tall windows” memberi informasi lokasi reading corner. Frasa lain menjelaskan benda di dalam ruangan, seperti panduan, permukaan meja, atau bagian lampu.

translationId.prompt: Frasa mana yang menunjukkan lokasi sudut baca baru?

questions.evidence: Last month, the school library opened a new reading corner beside its tall windows.

questions.prompt: Which noun group refers to the cushions?
questions.explanation: “Two soft floor cushions” adalah kelompok kata yang menamai bantal duduk. “Two” menunjukkan jumlah, “soft” menjelaskan sifatnya, dan “cushions” menjadi nomina inti.

translationId.prompt: Kelompok kata mana yang merujuk pada bantal duduk?

questions.evidence: Two soft floor cushions sit under a round table with a smooth surface.

questions.prompt: Why did the librarian place clear labels above each group of books?
choices: To make the wall look colourful.
To stop students from borrowing books.
To help younger students find the right section.
To show where the cushions should be placed.
questions.explanation: Kalimat tersebut menyatakan bahwa label membantu siswa yang lebih muda menemukan bagian buku yang tepat. Tujuan ini berkaitan dengan kemudahan menemukan buku, bukan menghias dinding atau mengatur bantal.

translationId.prompt: Mengapa pustakawan meletakkan label yang jelas di atas setiap kelompok buku?
choices: Untuk membantu siswa yang lebih muda menemukan bagian yang tepat.
Untuk menunjukkan tempat bantal harus diletakkan.

questions.evidence: The librarian placed clear labels above each group of books, so younger students can find the right section.
